title: Stability AI, maker of image generator Stable Diffusion, raises $76 million in fresh funding | TechCrunch
summary: The company announced the round Tuesday, saying the new capital comes partly from a number of prominent entertainment industry organizations, including Universal Music Group, Sony Music Group, and Warner Music Group, and gaming giant Electronic Arts (EA).
